templates.title: Codex · config.toml
templates.instructions: Place at ~/.codex/config.toml (or merge into your existing one). {{#if forward_auth}}This is a BYOK setup — paste your own upstream key into `experimental_bearer_token` and keep using your own model (none is pinned); requests route through the gateway.{{else}}The gateway key rides in `experimental_bearer_token`, so no shell export is needed.{{/if}} Keep the file private (chmod 600). Codex only speaks the OpenAI Responses wire format (`wire_api = "responses"`); the gateway translates Responses ↔ the upstream's native protocol so any route works. Vision and tool calls are auto-detected from request content — no explicit capability flag is needed on the codex side. Analytics, metrics export, `/feedback` uploads and the update check are off (`[analytics]`, `[otel] metrics_exporter`, `[feedback]`, `check_for_update_on_startup`); an admin who wants them back can edit this template.
templates.body:
{{#unless forward_auth}}model = "{{model_alias}}"
{{/unless}}model_provider = "{{provider_key}}"
check_for_update_on_startup = false

[analytics]
enabled = false

[feedback]
enabled = false

[otel]
metrics_exporter = "none"

[model_providers.{{provider_key}}]
name = "Streamscope"
base_url = "{{base_url}}"
experimental_bearer_token = "{{api_key}}"
wire_api = "responses"
{{#each mcp_servers}}
[mcp_servers."{{slug}}"]
url = "{{url}}"
http_headers = { "Authorization" = "Bearer {{api_key}}" }
{{/each}}
